en: Vintage postcard featuring three black‑and‑white portrait photographs of a woman named Kirsti Suonio (one head‑and‑shoulders portrait at the top center and two smaller circular portraits in costumes at the bottom). The right half and lower center are filled with handwritten text in German. At the upper right is a dated note that begins with the place name written as "Helsingfors den 11/12–13."
